description:
## 1.36.0-dev.109 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: preserve keyboard post-detail state without changing the existing comment-entry path.
- Reddit: skip comment child controls by advancing through Reddit's native focus chain rather than clearing focus.
- Reddit: recover the nearest replacement comment row after Collapse or Expand changes its Compose node ID.
- Reddit: show a subtle non-interactive tint on the comment targeted by O.
- Reddit: leave P preview behavior unchanged.
